evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: music search using content identification/fingerprinting (alternative techniques enumerated, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: profile-based music search/discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation/search based on similar users.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: content-similarity based search/discovery (variants enumerated, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: search using enriched metadata/image tags (inputs enumerated, not multiple features).

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: upload with tag persistence (propagation is a required effect of upload, not a separately specified feature).

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieve information about similar items/segments (items vs segments are types, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieval of info about perceptually similar videos/segments (single capability).

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation generation from similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendations based on local news events.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines person identification (detection/recognition) and enrichment (retrieving related information) which are independently implementable/testable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification and retrieval of related information are separable features that can be independently implemented and prioritized.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection and delivering related information are distinct, independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification and information enrichment are separable features and should be separate stories.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image-based recommendation (take or upload are input options, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Single map-based content discovery feature; 'walk around' is context, not a separate implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-enabled content search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Specifies three distinct actions (viewing, validating, editing) on segmentation, each independently implementable and testable.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines annotation (manual/crowd) and topic extraction (automated analysis) which are separable features.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are part of one A/V-quality-based content selection feature rather than clearly separable user stories here.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: quick edited-before-upload assessment.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: nudity prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefilter via low-level asset search.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic copyright validation of ingested content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefilter using high-level metadata/tags (inputs enumerated).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment feature that lists multiple input signals (enumeration of inputs, not multiple features).

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/alerting feature using specified inputs.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: volunteer type identification/classification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: preclassification using low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect images without classifiable animals.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic detection of image series due to timestamp malfunction.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribute preclassification (e.g., age, sex) as one capability.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting/detection of number of animals.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: plankton localization/segmentation (alternatives listed, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect images without classifiable plankton.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature measuring attributes (size/orientation enumerated as outputs), not multiple separate features.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: motion analysis to shorten video duration.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: event detection (egg-laying time).

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature listing target classes (enumeration of types, not multiple features).

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: weighting assessments based on volunteer experience.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature listing artifact examples (attributes), not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection capability covering moving/transient objects (related detections, not separate stories).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single audio-cleaning feature that lists related noise types; not two independent features.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping of whale calls by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting distinct whale callers in audio.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/notification feature about interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature specifying channel choice (options enumerated, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/education-trigger feature.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature about education medium (enumerated options are attributes).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selection of educational content.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect interesting comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/triggering feature for Zoonibot comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single trigger/behavior feature for Zoonibot explanations.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: content generation for Zoonibot messaging.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: subject grouping/clustering by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature using volunteer history as input.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: article summarization for reuse.
